versions.content: When receiving a request for UDS Service RoutineControl (0x31) with subfunction requestRoutineResults, if all verifications have been successfully done (see [SWS_Dcm_00568], [SWS_Dcm_00570], [SWS_Dcm_00571]), the Dcm module shall call the configured Xxx_RequestResults() function passing the dataIn, calculated from routineControlOptionRecord (see [SWS_Dcm_00590])and provide the dataOut reference according of the list of output signal configured for this routine ( see configu- ration parameter DcmDspRequestRoutineResultsOut ).
